tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// sho dgon pa 'gro mgon rin chen la spring pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bden par smra ba 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor// 'dus pa'i gtsug na stong nyid seng ge'i sgra// rdul bral dpag yas 'jam pa'i yan lag gis// sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i gsung rab ji bzhin chos smra zhing*// grub pa mchog brnyes du ma bzhugs pa'i gzhi// dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon par legs gnas pa// sde snod 'dzin pa de yi spring yig 'di// dam pa'i gdan sa dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gzhi// rtogs ldan 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rab gang ba// grub pa'i gnas mchog sho dgon dben gnas su// bzhugs pa'i 'gro mgon rin chen phyag tu 'bul// dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas zhing khams rnam par dag pa/ shar phyogs kyi rgyud sa gzhi dgos 'dod 'byung ba smar khams kyi cha/ chu klung dal gyis 'bab pa zla chab dkar mo'i ngogs/ phyogs kun na rin po che'i gter khang du ma dang ldan zhing*/ 'bru sna tshogs kyi 'byung khungs/ 'khor yug gi ri bo rab tu mtho zhing*/ sa gzhi yid du 'ong ba lhun po'i ngos la 'jam pa'i spang ljang me tog sna tshogs kyis mdzes par snang ba tsan+nan gyi nags tshal/ yal ga dang lo 'dab me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pas mdzes pa'i bya rnams snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa dang bcas pas/ dga' ba'i tshal kun du brgyan pa ltar/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyang yid 'dzin par byed pa'i gnas/ nyams myong dang rtogs pa 'phel bar byed pa'i dben gnas dam pa/ dpal gyi sho dgon na bzhugs pa/ tshul khrims dang bsgrub pa phun sum tshogs shing*/ rtogs pa dang mkhyen brtse'i yon tan khyad par can dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa rin po che gdan sa ba'i phyag tu 'bul ba/ khyed kyis bla ma dam pa rnams la sangs rgyas su 'dzin pa'i rnam par thar pa dang ldan pas/

chos rje sa skya pa chen po'i zhabs drung du rin po che phag mo grub pas gtugs/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mnos pa'i dbang gis nged la yang brgyud pa'i bla ma bzung nas/ nged kyi bu slob rnams kyi bdag gnyer mdzad cing*/ bstan pa'i srog shing du bzhugs nas sa skya pa dang khyad med du mdzad bya ba khyed rang gi slob ma ston pa tshul gzhon dag las thos/ de la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang*/ slad ma nged la hor gyi rgyal pos bla mchod la 'ong dgos bya ba'i gdan 'dren nan can yang yang byung bas da lo 'gro ba lags/ khyed kyis kyang rgyal po'i bla mchod rgyu dang*/ mi go chod 'ga' 'dab nor dang nged kyi zla la btang nas rgyal po'i gser yig dang 'ja' sa zhus na ngo lta brtan pa yin pas thugs la 'thad na nges rogs ldan gang dgos byed pa lags/ nged gar yod kyi sngon la mi thong*/ khyod kyi slob ma ston tshul la sogs pa kun yang yon tan che bar yod/ khyed la yang mos gus dang re gnyis ka che bar gda'/ khyed bstan pa'i sgor zhugs tshad rnams la sku gces pa nya dang tshes brgyad byung ngo cog la rnam rgyal stong mchod mang ba re mdzad par zhu/ yig rten du nged la ya tse rgyal pos khong rang gi thugs dam du bzhengs nas nged la phul ba'i gser sdud yig shog khyad par du 'phags shing*/ glegs shing gi rgyab rkos la yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba dang*/ ldum rdzings dang*/ pa tra la sogs pa bzo gnas khyad par 'phags pa du ma dang ldan pa/ tso'u zi dmar po dang*/ bo'u ras dkar po'i na bza' can snag 'bum cig dang ngo mnyam zer ba cig thugs dam du 'bul/ gzhan du mi gtang bar zhu/ ras dar tshon ma ya ba legs pa zhig dang*/ ka ra'i glang po che zhig 'bul zhing mchis/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum// bdag 'dzin bud shing bsreg pa'i ye shes me// ma rig mun pa bsal byed rin chen sgron// zab mo'i don ston gsung rab dri ma med// sdug bsngal nad kun sel byed sman gyi mchog

/zhal gsung pha rol phyin gzhung sum brgya pa// mthing shog gzhi la gser yig khyad par 'phags// glegs shing ngos la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sku// 'dzam bu'i gser las bzo gnas du mas brgyan// dbus gtsang mthil na khyad par 'phags pa 'di// dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'du ba'i pho brang du// mi mchog khyed la mchod pa'i rten du 'bul// ka shi'i ras dang ka ra'i glang po mchog /dngos po shin tu phra bar gyur na yang*// dga' ba'i yid kyis ring nas bskur ba 'di// mos pa'i stobs kyis phyag tu phyin nas kyang*// dwangs shing dgyes pa'i thugs kyis bzhes nas su// gzhan phan thugs las chung la mi gzhol zhu// 'dir smras pa/ rtogs pa zla mdzes yon tan dkyil 'khor rgyas// phrin las bsil 'od nyon mongs gdung ba sel// slob ma kun+da'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad pa// skyes mchog ri bong 'dzin pa rgyal gyur cig dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
